fi; if [ -n "$BROKER_PID" ]; then kill "$BROKER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$BROKER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; rm -rf "$TMPDIR_LAB"; }; trap cleanup EXIT; OPENAI_API_KEY=dummy-never-used AI_CALL_BRIDGE_BROKER_TOKEN="$TOKEN" python3 scripts/realtime_credential_broker.py --port "$PORT" >"$TMPDIR_LAB/broker.out" 2>"$TMPDIR_LAB/broker.err" & BROKER_PID=$!; READY=0; for i in $(seq 1 50); do CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 1 "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/" || true); if [ "$CODE" = 405 ]; then READY=1; break; fi; sleep 0.1; done; test "$READY" -eq 1; cloudflared tunnel --url "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT" --no-autoupdate >"$TMPDIR_LAB/tunnel.out" 2>"$TMPDIR_LAB/tunnel.err" & TUNNEL_PID=$!; URL=''; for i in $(seq 1 120); do URL=$(grep -Eo 'https://[a-z0-9-]+\.trycloudflare\.com' "$TMPDIR_LAB/tunnel.err" | head -n 1 || true); if [ -n "$URL" ]; then break; fi; if ! kill -0 "$TUNNEL_PID" 2>/dev/null; then cat "$TMPDIR_LAB/tunnel.err"; exit 1; fi; sleep 0.25; done; test -n "$URL"; HTTP_CODE=$(curl -sS -o "$TMPDIR_LAB/unauth.json" -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 20 -X POST "$URL/v1/realtime/client-secret" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{}'); test "$HTTP_CODE" = 401; grep -q '"error":"unauthorized"' "$TMPDIR_LAB/unauth.json"; echo quick_tunnel_broker_auth_boundary_green=true; cleanup; trap - EXIT; git diff --check; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; echo offcall_lab_full_green=true
